lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Canada-U.S. liquor bans ‘hurting people on both sides of the border,’ says distiller, The Canadian Press reports.
Mark Carney and his European Union counterparts closed a major summit Friday by announcing what they called an ‘alliance for the future.’, The Canadian Press reports.

Evacuees from Russian-occupied Oleshky began the long journey out of the war-ravaged region in bus convoys Friday, on the fourth day of the most significant truce since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine four-and-a-half years ago, The Associated Press reports.
An ICE officer is charged with assault for striking a man with a car in Houston, The Associated Press reports.

Christa Pike said Friday she remains in constant pain, struggles to speak and has been largely isolated in a prison hospital after surviving a lethal injection in Tennessee last month, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
